name: TransferToBeneficiaryAction
description: Leaf action. Sends its whole input to the address in its node data, abi.encode(address), picked by whoever triggers the flow. Use it only where the caller may direct the funds: under a Merkle claim budget or on a flow with a restricted trigger.
